summary: Champions League Tuesday: 11 games researched, 5 kept (all medium confidence): Barcelona v Aston Villa (Barça 75%), LASK v Slovan Bratislava (LASK 70%), Feyenoord v Inter (Inter 49.5%), Galatasaray v Stuttgart (Galatasaray 45%) and Chapecoense v Mirassol (Mirassol 43.5%). Excluded: Internacional v Coritiba (Coritiba coach sacked 7 days ago, Inter midfield doubts), Shakhtar v Sporting (Sporting coach left, neutral venue), Man United v Roma (conflicting reports on United starters, unexplained 10% price move), Atlético v Bayern (Bayern GK doubt, Kompany absent), Villarreal v PSG (unexplained 7-8% drift, PSG left-back fitness), Bodø/Glimt v Lille (virus in the squad, Hauge reported differently, 70 km/h gusts).

checks.team_news: Barcelona have four defenders out. Koundé (ankle) and Eric García (thigh) trained away from the group Monday and are ruled out (Rotowire). Xavi Espart has a syndesmosis injury, out about 7 weeks. Christensen (thigh/quad) will not be risked (Al Jazeera) and is 'not yet ready' (Football365); Rotowire calls him unclear because he missed Monday's session. He is in no predicted XI. Also out: Olmo (adductor) and Bardghji (ACL). Raphinha is fit and started Saturday. Pedri came off at half-time vs Alavés with no injury reported. Villa are without Wan-Bissaka and Ruggeri (hamstrings) and Onana (ACL, long term). Madjo and Cissé are not in the UCL squad. Maatsen is back from an ankle injury. Cash's Premier League ban does not apply here. Neither side's goalkeeper is in doubt.
checks.lineups: Barcelona, from Rotowire, EverythingBarca, Al Jazeera and Starting11: all four agree on Joan García, Cubarsí, Cancelo, Rodri, Pedri, Fermín, Yamal, Raphinha and Gordon. They split on one or two back-line spots: De Jong at CB with Fariñas at RB (Rotowire, and an AS report via Yahoo) vs Gerard Martín and Balde (EverythingBarca, Al Jazeera). Villa, from Rotowire, AstonVillaReview and Al Jazeera: all agree on Suzuki; Cash, Lindelöf, Torres, Maatsen; Kamara, McGinn, Manzambi and Jackson. The last two midfield/wide spots vary between Gomes, Buendía, Barkley, Alysson and Goretzka. Those are selection choices, not fitness doubts.
checks.rotation: Barcelona: previous game Sat 31 Oct, 6-1 at home to Alavés. Next game Sun 8 Nov at Atlético Madrid (La Liga's top two), five days after this one. Flick: 'I'm focused on the next match.' I found no talk of rotation, and every predicted XI is first-choice, so expect 1–3 changes, mostly forced by the defensive injuries. Villa: Fulham 1-1 on 31 Oct, after rotating for the 28 Oct Carabao Cup loss at Bournemouth (Jackson and Manzambi rested). Next game Sun 8 Nov at Man United. Expect Villa near full strength.
checks.motivation: In the UCL league-phase table Barcelona are 8th with 6 points and Villa are 2nd with 9 (ESPN standings). Flick is 'aiming for top eight' (club site), so both sides have real stakes. Barcelona are 1st in La Liga and Villa 10th in the Premier League. Not a derby: it is the first meeting since 1983. Flick and Emery are both in post, and I found no manager change.
checks.form: Barcelona have played 14 competitive games: 12 wins, 0 draws, 2 losses (2-4 at PSG on 20 Oct, 1-2 at home to Real Madrid on 25 Oct). Last 8: 31 goals for, 13 against. At home they have won 6 of 7. Over the last 8 they averaged about 20.8 shots for and 8.3 against (ESPN box scores). Villa's last 8: W3-2 Tottenham, D2-2 Brentford, W6-0 Fenerbahçe, W1-0 at Newcastle, W3-1 Viking, W2-1 Man City, L0-3 Bournemouth (cup), D1-1 Fulham. That is 18 goals for and 10 against, with about 16.7 shots for and 14.7 against. Villa away: L0-4 Brighton, D0-0 Hull, W at Brugge, Tottenham and Newcastle. I could not get xG: Understat returned 503, FBref and Sofascore 403, the FotMob API 404, and ClubElo was unreachable, so shot counts stand in for it.
checks.h2h: The only previous meetings were the 1983 Super Cup: Barcelona won 1-0 at Camp Nou and Villa won 3-0 at home (3-1 on aggregate). As a manager, Emery is W3 D6 L21 against Barcelona (20% draws, per Al Jazeera) and has won once in 15 visits to Camp Nou (Football365). Style: Barcelona's high line and attack against Villa's counters through Jackson (8 goals in his last 9 starts, per EverythingBarca). Both teams scored in all 5 of Barcelona's last games (Goal), which points to an open game rather than a cagey draw.

Also from Rotowire (OddsJam, 2 Nov): bet365 -400/+650/+700 = 0.756/0.126/0.118, BetMGM -425/+600/+825 = 0.763/0.135/0.102, Kalshi -404/+622/+837. Betway 1.25/7.00/8.00 (Gainblers) = 0.749/0.134/0.117. Football365 quotes 5/19, 13/2, 10/1 = 0.779/0.131/0.089. Sportsline shows BetMGM -323. Book average is about 0.751/0.135/0.114. Polymarket over 24h: home 0.785→0.775 (−1.3%), draw flat at 0.125, away 0.095→0.105. The steady drift away from Barcelona fits the defensive injury news and stays under 5% in the last 24h. Stake and Rainbet both returned 403.

Squawka (49/19/32) and Foresportia (Villa favoured) appeared only in search snippets. Both pages returned 403, so I did not read them and did not use them.
checks.venue_weather: Spotify Camp Nou, Barcelona's normal home ground. Villa have a roughly 2-hour flight. Open-Meteo for kick-off: rain likely (90%+, about 1–3 mm/h), 11°C, wind about 10 km/h with gusts to about 25 km/h. Wet but not extreme. I found no pitch issues reported.

games.reason: I started from the Polymarket price of 0.774/0.123/0.103 and moved Barcelona down about 2.4 points, splitting it between the draw and Villa. The average of four bookmakers (DraftKings now, bet365, BetMGM, Betway) is about 0.751/0.135/0.114, and Opta's 72/15.3/12.7 is lower still, so Polymarket is the most Barcelona-friendly price. DraftKings has drifted from -450 to -340 as Barcelona's defence has fallen apart: Koundé, Eric García, Christensen and Espart are all out, De Jong or youngster Fariñas is likely to fill in, and Barcelona have not kept a UCL clean sheet since April 2025 (Football365). Villa are in form: 9/9 points in the UCL and wins over Man City and Newcastle. Two things keep the draw low. Barcelona have drawn 0 of 14 this season, and games are expected to be high-scoring (DraftKings total line 4.5; both teams scored in Barcelona's last 5). At 13.5% the draw is far below the 25% cap for a straight win. Confidence is medium rather than high: Barcelona's back line is unsettled, the drift is against the favourite, and I could not get xG.
games.main_risk: Barcelona's makeshift defence (De Jong at centre-back, four defenders out, goals conceded in each of the last 5 games, including 4 at PSG and 2 at home to Real Madrid) gets caught on the counter by Jackson and Villa, giving a 2-2 type draw or a Villa win. The evidence for this is real but already priced in. Against it, Barcelona have not drawn all season and outshoot opponents about 21 to 8.

checks.team_news: Slovan: coach Yaya Touré said at Monday's press conference that Alasana Yirajang and Roman Čerepkai are out. Mykola Kukharevych is training again but is not on the UEFA squad list (skslovan.com). Sporticos lists Šporar as 'doubtful', but the club's own match report shows he started and played 74 minutes at Podbrezová on 31 Oct, and Touré named only Yirajang and Čerepkai as missing, so I treat that label as stale aggregator data. LASK: the club preview mentions no absences. FootballPredictions lists Harakate out (knee), George Bello doubtful (muscle), and Cheikne and Smakaj off the roster. Bello did not start any of LASK's last four games (ESPN line-ups), so no likely starter is in doubt. Squawka (search snippet only, page returned 403) says no fresh LASK concerns. No goalkeeper doubt on either side: Jungwirth is LASK's regular keeper; Slovan used Takáč in the UCL and Popovič in the league, and both were fit on 31 Oct.
checks.lineups: FootballPredictions' expected LASK XI (3-4-3): Jungwirth; Alemão, Dibango, Mbuyamba; Ljubičić, Horvath, Elfadli, Schöpf; Lang, Adeniran, Usor. Squawka's (snippet) is also 3-4-3 but includes Andrade and Daněk. The two agree on the core (Jungwirth, Alemão, Mbuyamba, Dibango, Ljubičić, Lang), and ESPN's actual XIs from the last four games confirm that core. FootballPredictions' Slovan XI is garbled (no goalkeeper, youth players Tománek and Hofstädter). Slovan's recent UCL XIs were Takáč; Markovič, Bajrič, Pokorný, Cruz; Blackman, Gajdoš, Ibrahim; Camara, Barseghyan, Marcelli or Šporar. No confirmed XIs yet; the sources differ in detail.
checks.rotation: LASK: ÖFB Cup on Wed 28 Oct vs Ried, won 5-4 after extra time (120 minutes); league on Sat 31 Oct vs Tirol, won 2-1; next is away at Ried in the league on Sat 7 Nov (lask.at). LASK swap players between league and UCL games: the XI vs Tirol differed by about 5 from the XI at Sporting. Those changes would restore the European XI rather than weaken it, and Kühbauer has not talked about resting players: 'from the first minute we want to show we want to win.' Slovan: Wed 28 Oct at Trenčín (rescheduled league game, won 2-0) and Sat 31 Oct at Podbrezová (2 changes, won 2-1). Next is a home league game vs Trenčín (date not checked). Both sides are on their third game in 7 days; LASK carry extra load from the 120-minute cup tie.
checks.motivation: UEFA's own match API confirms this is UCL League Phase Matchday 4 (not Europa or Conference League). LASK are 24th with 3 points, the last play-off place, and a win keeps their knockout hopes alive. Slovan are 36th with 0 points and goal difference -12, chasing their first point. Both managers are settled: Kühbauer since Oct 2025, contract extended to 2029; Touré since June 2026. No sacking or appointment in the last 14 days. Not a derby: the clubs have never met in a competitive game.
checks.form: LASK, last 10 (FootballPredictions): W4 D1 L5. Scored 2.2 and conceded 2.4 per game; xG 1.91 for, 1.48 against. At home they concede 3.2 per game with no clean sheet in their last 5. Recent results: L 0-1 at AEK, L 3-6 vs Liverpool (outshot 12-26), W 4-0 at Lustenau, W 3-2 at Sporting, L 1-3 vs Salzburg, W 5-4 aet vs Ried (3-3 after 90), W 2-1 vs Tirol. They are 3rd in the Austrian league. Slovan, last 10: 1.8 points per game, xG 1.88 for, 1.29 against; away they won 5 of 7 with 1.86 scored and 1.14 conceded per game. In the UCL they lost 1-6 at PSG, 0-3 vs Stuttgart (1 shot on target) and 0-4 at Roma (1 shot in total). In the league: W 3-0 at Trnava, D 2-2 vs Dukla, W 2-0 at Trenčín, W 2-1 at Podbrezová; 2nd in the Niké liga.
checks.h2h: No previous competitive meeting (lask.at: 'first competitive duel'). Style: LASK play an attacking 3-4-3 or 5-3-2 with a leaky defence (BTTS in 70% of their last 10). Slovan sit deep in a 4-1-4-1 in Europe and have created almost nothing against top sides. Totals are high (DraftKings O/U line 3.5, over -125), and high-scoring games make a draw less likely.
checks.odds: DraftKings (ESPN API): -290 / +475 / +650 (1.345 / 5.75 / 7.50), de-vigged 70.8 / 16.5 / 12.7. It opened at -235 / +390 / +500 (about 65.4 / 19.0 / 15.5), so the price has firmed toward LASK. Bet365 (via Gainblers): -303 / +450 / +700, de-vigged 71.0 / 17.2 / 11.8. Sporticos shows 1.40 / 5.00 / 7.00; KickOff's best LASK price is 1.44. Polymarket LASK yes moved 0.685 → 0.715 in 24h (+4.4% relative, under the 5% trigger) and from 0.665 over 7 days. Draw went 0.185 → 0.165 and Slovan 0.135 → 0.115. The drift matches Slovan's absences and the away-fan ban, both announced on 2 Nov.
checks.models: Opta supercomputer (theanalyst.com): LASK 63.0%, draw 19.1%, Slovan 17.9%. KickOff algorithm: LASK 68%, home-or-draw 86% (so draw about 18%), DNB 80%. Squawka 68 / 15 / 16 (snippet only). Sporticos shows 46 / 23 / 31, which looks like an outlier. ClubElo failed to connect twice; Forebet returned 403.
checks.venue_weather: Raiffeisen Arena (Oberösterreich Arena in UEFA's naming), Linz, LASK's normal home ground, about 19,080 capacity; referee Donatas Rumšas (LTU). The away sector will stay closed, so no Slovan fans (skslovan.com), which is a small extra home edge. Travel from Bratislava is about 250 km by road; the team arrived on Monday. Open-Meteo forecast for kick-off: about 6°C, overcast, dry, wind 7-8 km/h. No pitch problems reported.

games.reason: I started from Polymarket (71.7 / 16.7 / 11.7), which matches the de-vigged DraftKings (70.8 / 16.5 / 12.7) and Bet365 (71.0 / 17.2 / 11.8) prices. I moved about 1.7 points from home to draw/away for three cited reasons: (1) the bookmaker-free models are below the market on LASK (Opta 63.0 / 19.1 / 17.9; KickOff about 68 / 18 / 14); (2) LASK's home defence is poor, conceding 3.2 per game with no clean sheet in their last 5 home games (FootballPredictions); (3) LASK played a 120-minute cup tie on Wednesday and a league game on Saturday before this one. I kept the move small because the rest points the other way: Slovan are without Yirajang and Čerepkai, have no fans in the stadium, managed 1 shot on target vs Stuttgart and 1 shot at Roma, and are 36th with -12 goal difference. LASK are at full strength apart from Harakate, motivated (24th, a win keeps them in the knockout race) and won at Sporting. No exclusion rule fires. Šporar's 'doubtful' tag comes only from an aggregator and is contradicted by the club's 31 Oct report. The 24h move in the favourite's price is +4.4%. Both managers are settled, it is not a derby, and the venue and weather are normal. Draw at 18% is below the 25% limit for a straight-win leg.
games.main_risk: LASK's leaky defence (2.4 conceded per game, no home clean sheet in 5) and tired legs after a 120-minute cup tie let Slovan steal a goal on the break. Slovan are strong away at home in Slovakia, and Barseghyan, Šporar or Camara could score. The likeliest bad outcome is a 1-1 or 2-2 draw, possibly from a late equaliser, as in LASK's 3-3 after 90 minutes against Ried. Both coaches called it 'on par' (Kühbauer) or '50:50 if we match the intensity' (Touré). The draw was raised to 18% to cover this.

games.reason: EXCLUDE on two rule triggers. (1) Coritiba sacked Fernando Seabra on 27 Oct 2026, 7 days before kick-off; interim Guila Bossle has had one game and a new 4-3-1-2. (2) Inter's likely starters Alan Patrick and Thiago Maia are doubts after coming off injured against Fluminense, and lineup sources disagree on Inter's midfield and back three. The market favourite is also weak on its record: Inter are 18th, won only 5 of 16 at home and drew 11 of 33. The DraftKings price has drifted from -185 to -160 (de-vig home 0.58), and Starting11's model gives the draw 45%. H2H is 9 draws in 19, and the first-round game was 2-2. So p shades home down and draw up from the market (0.603/0.223/0.173 → 0.58/0.245/0.175). A straight win is not allowed with the draw above 0.25 by those numbers anyway.
games.main_risk: A tense, low-quality relegation-zone game ends level. Inter without Alan Patrick and Thiago Maia struggle to break down a Coritiba side lifted by a new interim coach (a new-manager bounce after the 2-0 over Vitória), and it finishes 1-1 or 0-0. Inter draw a third of their games, and the last H2H was 2-2.

checks.team_news: PSG squad list (21 players, published 2 Nov 10:56) confirms four starters out: Dembélé (thigh/hamstring), Marquinhos (thigh), Nuno Mendes and Kvaratskhelia (ACL, out for the season). All four were injured on or around the 20 Oct win over Barcelona. Keeper Longoni is back in the squad. VIPSG and FutbolFantasy both report that the only senior left-backs, Lucas Hernández (projected starter) and Lucas Digne (who cramped), came back from Le Havre with muscle fatigue, and that their fitness will be checked before the match. Villarreal: Gerard Moreno has an adductor injury and is ruled out per FutbolFantasy/Eurosport but only 'doubtful/very uncertain' per VIPSG/CulturePSG. Foyth and Akhomach are out, Diatta is doubtful, and Saliba has just rejoined training. Pape Gueye is available because his LaLiga ban does not apply in Europe.

Not a derby or rivalry. Coaches: Iñigo Pérez was appointed by Villarreal on 1 June 2026 and Luis Enrique is long-standing, so no change in the last 14 days.

Away results: Marseille 2-1, Man City 4-2 (xG 1.83 to 2.63), Strasbourg 3-1. Villarreal's last 5: D 0-0 Elche, L 3-4 at Liverpool, W 2-1 at Valencia, W 5-0 Manacor (cup), L 0-1 Espanyol. games.reason: Excluded. (1) The favourite's Polymarket price fell 6.6–8.1% (relative) in the last 24h, overnight between 22:00 and 05:00 UTC. No new injury news came out at that time: the four absences date from 20 Oct and the squad list was published about 11h before the move. DraftKings also drifted from -170 to -145. They concede about 1.8 xG per game and Villarreal have scored in every UCL game. A home goal or late equaliser ends it level (e.g. 2-2), or Villarreal win outright as the drifting price suggests.
